cause: Upstream 95c5386ddb8a '[RISCV][NFCI] Rationalize Immediate Definitions (#120718)' gave generic RISCVUImmOp (so uimm5) EncoderMethod=getImmOpValue and a constant-only MCOperandPredicate. The fork used uimm5 for the lp.setupi end-of-loop label ($uimmS of LOOP0setupi/LOOP1setupi); at 19 it used the default getMachineOpValue, where the fork's mc hunk emits fixup_pulpv2_loop_setupi. At 20 it went to getImmOpValue, which has no PULP fixup -> assertion. lp.setup/lp.starti/lp.endi use the fork operand uimm12pcrel (plain Operand, no EncoderMethod) and were unaffected.
fix: RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td (insn-tablegen cluster, not mc as guessed): new fork operand uimm5pcrel declared like uimm12pcrel (default encoder, UImmAsmOperand<5>, decodeUImmOperand<5>, OPERAND_UIMM5, 5-bit ImmLeaf), used for $uimmS of LOOP0setupi/LOOP1setupi. No MC C++ changed. Follows upstream's design of a dedicated label operand for vendor PC-relative operands (cv.beqimm uses simm13_lsb0: RISCVInstrInfoXCV.td:505, RISCVInstrInfo.td:271 at llvmorg-20.1.8).
verification: Repro logs/20-R001.repro.log (port-20 clang asserts at RISCVMCCodeEmitter.cpp:555). Rebuild logs/20-R001.verify.log: clang llc llvm-mc llvm-objdump build, cluster_errors 0 clusters. Reproducer compiles rc 0 and 'llvm-objdump -dr' is identical to port-19 (lp.setupi x0, 0x3e8, 0x6 = 3e83507b, no relocations in either). Same with -mllvm -pulp-loop-range-immediate=0 (lp.starti/lp.endi/lp.counti): identical to port-19. Port-20-generated .s for a file with lp.setup/lp.starti/lp.endi/lp.counti/lp.setupi: port-19 and fixed build behave identically. Numeric-operand asm (lp.setupi x0/x1, lp.setup, lp.starti, lp.endi, lp.counti) assembles byte-identical to port-19.
